chapter.verse: Ka Pasian aw, ka galte kiang panin keimah hong honkhia in, keimah langpanga hong dingte kiang panin kei hong dal in,
siatna a bawlte’ kiang panin hong khahkhia in la, mi that nuamte’ kiang panin keimah hong hon in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, en in, amaute in kei hong pangsim uh hi; mi kihtak-huaite in keimah hong langpangin kikaikhawm uh hi. Topa aw, kei’ thu palsatna, kei’ mawhna hang hi lo,
kei’ khialhna hang hi lopi-in, amaute tai-in va kithawi uh hi. Nangmah in hong phawk tawm in, keimah huh dingin hong pai in la, en in!
Nang, Vanglianpen Topa Pasian in, Israel’ Pasian na hi hi. Minam khempeuh daantat dingin tho in la, khemna tawh siat gamtat ding a sawmte kuamah siit kei in.
Nitak simin amaute hong pai kikin, ui bangin ku uh a, khua sungah vak khuankhuan uh hi.
Amaute tua lai-ah a kam uh tawh hawk a, a muk uh tawh zuau gen uh hi—bang hang hiam cih leh, “Kua’n hong za laizang ding ahi hiam?” ci-in amaute in ngaihsun uh hi.
Topa aw, ahih hangin nangmah in amaute na nuihsan lel a, minam khempeuh na zahpih hi.
Ka Thahatna aw, nangmah phatnate ka sa ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, Pasian aw, nangmah in ka munkip muan’huai na hi hi.
Ka Pasian in ama itna kip tawh kei hong dawn ding a, ka Pasian in gualzawhna tawh ka galte hong ensak ding hi.
Amaute that kei in, that lecin ka mite in mangngilh ding hi; na vangliatna tawh amaute kilok gawp sak in la, amaute niamkhiat in, Topa, komau’ lum aw!
Amau kam-a mawhna, amau muk tawh a pauna thu hangin, amau’ kiphatsakna-ah amau mah awksak in. Hamsiatna zangin zuauthu a genna hangun,
lei mong dongin Jakob’ tungah Pasian maang hi, ci-in mite in a theih nadingin hehna tawh amaute beisak in la, amaute a bei khit mateng sisak in.
Nitak simin amaute hong pai kikin, ui bangin ku uh a, khua sungah vak khuankhuan uh hi.
Amaute an zongin vak kawikawi uh a, an a kham uh ngah kei leh humham uh hi.

Ahih hangin keimah in nangma vangliatna la ka sa ding a, zingsangin na itna kip phatna la nakpi-in ka sa ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in keima munkip muan’huai na hi a, ka gentheih hunin keima belh na hi hi.
Ka Thahatna aw, nangmah phatnate ka sa ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian aw, nangmah in ka munkip muan’huai, kei tungah itna kip hong lak Pasian na hi hi.
